passage.text:
Every consequential element of a rendering should identify the record entry it came from and the exact source version and passage supporting that entry. Traceability is required, but it is not proof of correctness.**

This is the fixed-page escape hatch made finer. A reader ought to be able to move from a diagram edge or table cell to a record entry, and then to the relevant passage in the unchanged source version. A locator that merely points somewhere in the document is not enough. A cited passage can be genuine while the claim attributed to it is wrong. The walk back makes correction possible. It does not perform the correction.

## Before the record

The record also needs a construction
